verdict.rationale: Docs describe robust cloud/async capabilities—long-running cloud sessions, teleport, remote control, Slack-to-PR workflows, automatic GitHub code review, and multi-agent orchestration—that align with building, testing, and delivering a reviewable feature end-to-end. However, hands-on community reports describe frequent failures to self-verify, destructive edits (e.g., replace_all bugs), degrading output quality, and near-100% failure rates on some tasks, directly undercutting the reliability implied by the docs.
